Grain merchandising
In the grain trading business for over 40 years.
Grain merchandising is at our core; the very foundation upon which Hannebaum Grain is built. Our success comes from our experience, expertise, and the relationships we’ve cultivated and grown within the midwest agriculture community since day one. If you’re a farmer, elevator, or feed yard looking to maximize the return on your hard work, we’re not just here to serve your operation—we’re here to be a part of your operation.
